# Custom n8n Nodes Catalog

Этот каталог нужен для агентов и внешних skills, которые создают workflow без доступа к исходникам `n8n-nodes-custom`.
Цель - не дать модели угадывать `resource`, `operation`, credentials и область применения кастомных нод.

Источник анализа: репозиторий `sme-tools/n8n-nodes-custom`, tag `v0.3.26`,
commit `da527108ac52604d238ce43013e34d0cb30527b9` от 31-Aug-2026.
Проверено: 04-Sep-2026. Пакет рассчитан на n8n `>=2.0.0`, peer dependency — `^2.16.0`.

## Hard Rules

- Перед использованием кастомной ноды проверь, что целевой n8n действительно имеет пакет `@sme-tools/n8n-nodes-custom`.
- Не выдумывай `resource`, `operation`, credential type или параметры. Если операции нет в этом файле, остановись и проверь live export/UI/source.
- В workflow exports кастомные типы могут выглядеть как `CUSTOM.<nodeName>` или как instance-specific `n8n-nodes-base.<nodeName>`; не угадывай точный `type`, бери его из live export/template.
- Если кастомная нода не установлена или параметры не подтверждены, используй `HTTP Request` с credential или оставь `Sticky Note` с `TODO in UI`.
- Secrets, API keys, service accounts и hidden `accessToken` никогда не писать в workflow JSON или документацию.
- Для слабой модели: сначала выбери домен по таблице ниже, потом только `resource/operation`. Не начинай с генерации JSON.

## Decision Matrix

| Need | Prefer custom node | Fallback |
|------|--------------------|----------|
| Confluence pages, search and attachments | `Wiki` | HTTP Request to Confluence REST API |
| Calendar events, busy/free slots | `Kronos` | HTTP Request / external calendar API |
| People lookup by login/email/id/division | `PeopleHub` | HTTP Request to people API |
| GitLab files, issues, MRs, pipelines, releases | `GitLab` | HTTP Request with GitLab token |
| GitLab webhook/notification trigger | `GitLab Trigger` | Webhook + external GitLab integration |
| Jira issues, comments, attachments and fix versions | `Jira Software` | HTTP Request to Jira REST API |
| Jira create/update events | `Jira Trigger` | Schedule/Webhook + Jira query |
| RAG projects, datasources, file upload, chunk query | `Rag Platform` | HTTP Request to RAG API |
| DWH SQL query | `DWH (DLH - Trino)` | HTTP Request / approved DWH connector |
| Sage search, short links and alert mutes | `Sage` | HTTP Request to Sage API |
| HashiCorp Vault secret retrieval | `Vault` | Approved secrets integration; never inline a secret |
| Internal MCP Hub tools for AI Agent | `n8n MCP` | Native MCP Client Tool when its auth is suitable |
| T-Tracker tasks and related entities | `T-Tracker` | HTTP Request to T-Tracker API |
| T-Tracker create/update events | `T-Tracker Trigger` | Polling/API integration |
| LLM for AI Agent / AI Chain | `T-Bank LLM proxy` | OpenAI-compatible language model node |
| LLM with tracing | `T-Bank LLM proxy with Langfuse` | LLM proxy without tracing |
| Manual LLM demo only | `T-Bank LLM DEMO` | Do not use in production workflow |
| Quick Python in MLCore | `Python (MLCore)` | Code node for local JS logic; MLC job for heavy jobs |
| Full MLC job orchestration | `MLC Job (Beta)` | Python MLCore for simple script execution |
| Allure/TestOps launches, test plans, jobs | `Allure` | HTTP Request to Allure/TestOps API |
| Dev Platform users/build links | `Dev Platform` | HTTP Request to Dev Platform API |
| Incidents, schedules, teams, units, releases | `FineDog` | HTTP Request to incident/on-call API |

## Node Catalog

### Allure

- Code name: `allure`
- Credential: `allureApi`
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: Allure/TestOps jobs, launches, test plans, trees and custom field values.
- Resources and operations:
  - `customFieldValue`: `getAll`
  - `job`: `create`, `delete`, `get`, `getByExternal`, `getJobRun`, `rerun`, `run`, `sync`, `update`
  - `launch`: `close`, `create`, `delete`, `get`, `getAll`, `getStatistic`, `getTree`, `merge`, `reopen`, `update`
  - `testPlan`: `create`, `delete`, `get`, `getJobs`, `getAll`, `removeJob`, `reset`, `run`, `sync`, `update`, `updateJobParameters`
  - `tree`: `getAll`, `get`

### Wiki

- Code name: `wiki`
- Credentials:
  - `spiritOAuth2Api` for delegated user authentication (default);
  - `confluenceApi` for a personal access token.
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: Confluence page create/update/search, children and attachments.
- Operations:
  - `createPage`
  - `deleteArchivePage`
  - `downloadAttachments`
  - `getPage`
  - `getPageChildren`
  - `searchPages`
  - `updatePageFullReplace`
  - `uploadNewAttachment`
  - `upsertPage`
- Rules:
  - delegated auth uses one reusable Spirit Sign In credential;
  - `updatePageFullReplace` replaces the entire `body.storage`, so fetch the current page first;
  - treat delete as irreversible and archive/trash as the recoverable default;
  - keep attachment data in the configured binary property.

### Dev Platform

- Code name: `devplatform`
- Credential: `devplatformApi`
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: build links and Dev Platform user lookup/presence.
- Resources and operations:
  - `buildLink`: `getAll`
  - `user`: `getAll`, `checkPresence`

### GitLab

- Code name: `gitlab`
- Credentials: `gitlabApi` or `devplatformApi`; package default auth option is Dev Platform token.
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: GitLab repository operations where native/community GitLab node is not the project standard.
- Resources and operations:
  - `file`: `create`, `delete`, `edit`, `get`, `list`, `search`
  - `issue`: `create`, `createComment`, `edit`, `get`, `lock`
  - `mergeRequest`: `create`, `createComment`, `get`, `getComments`, `getAll`, `getStatus`, `merge`
  - `pipeline`: `run`, `getAll`, `get`
  - `release`: `create`, `delete`, `get`, `getAll`, `update`
  - `repository`: `get`, `getIssues`, `getMany`
  - `user`: `getRepositories`

### GitLab Trigger

- Code name: `gitlabTrigger`
- Credential: `devplatformApi`
- Use for: Dev Platform notification-manager backed GitLab events.
- Notes:
  - trigger node, not a regular action node;
  - webhook path is handled by the node/UI;
  - event filters are loaded dynamically from Dev Platform;
  - beta node: verify in UI before relying on it.

### Jira Software

- Code name: `jira`
- Default node version: `2.1`
- Credentials for the current version:
  - `spiritOAuth2Api` for delegated user authentication (default);
  - `jiraSoftwareServerPatApi` for a server PAT;
  - `jiraSoftwareTcsApi` for the legacy TCS server credential.
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: Jira issues, comments, attachments, users, links and fix versions.
- Resources and operations:
  - `fixversion`: `create`, `delete`, `get`, `getAll`, `update`
  - `issue`: `changelog`, `create`, `createLink`, `createRemoteLink`, `delete`, `deleteRemoteLink`, `get`, `getAll`, `getAllRemoteLinks`, `notify`, `transitions`, `update`
  - `issueAttachment`: `add`, `get`, `getAll`, `remove`
  - `issueComment`: `add`, `get`, `getAll`, `remove`, `update`
  - `user`: `create`, `delete`, `get`
- Rules:
  - use the `2.1` operation set for new workflows; older node versions have a smaller contract;
  - delegated Spirit Sign In is the preferred personal authentication when available;
  - do not invent Jira instance, project keys, custom fields, transitions or user identifiers;
  - `getAll`/JQL paths need explicit paging and `ORDER BY`.

### Jira Trigger

- Code name: `jiraTrigger`
- Use for: Jira issue-created and issue-updated events delivered through the instance Kafka/Redis integration.
- Events:
  - `issueCreated`
  - `issueUpdated`
- Filters: Jira instance, project key, issue type, assignee, reporter and status.
- Notes:
  - requires instance-side Kafka/Redis configuration; no workflow credential is configured in the node;
  - manual execution waits up to 60 seconds for an event;
  - prefer Schedule/Webhook + query when the target instance has not confirmed trigger infrastructure.

### Kronos

- Code name: `kronos`
- Credential: `confluenceApi` for event create/user event operations.
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: calendar/free slot workflows and event creation.
- Operations:
  - `createEvent`
  - `findFreeSlots`
  - `getUserEvents`
  - `getUserBusySlots`
- Env dependencies from package:
  - `KRONOS_API_KEY`
  - `KRONOS_TIME_BOT_TOKEN` for approval/send-and-wait behavior
- Agent rule: for scheduling workflows, prefer `Kronos` over generic date math when the package is installed; keep dates absolute and timezone-explicit.

### n8n MCP

- Code name: `mcpHubTool`
- Credential: `spiritOAuth2Api`
- Output: AI Tool connection for an AI Agent.
- Use for: discovering an internal MCP Hub server and exposing all, selected or all-except-selected tools to an agent.
- Instance dependency: `MCP_HUB_CATALOG_URL`.
- Rules:
  - this node consumes MCP tools; it is not an MCP Server Trigger;
  - server URL, transport and headers come from the Hub catalog, not from workflow parameters;
  - one reusable Spirit Sign In credential supplies delegated user identity;
  - restrict tool selection to the minimum needed set, especially for tools with write actions.

### MLC Job

- Code name: `mlcJob`
- Credential: `mlcoreApi`
- Use for: long-running MLCore cluster jobs and artifact handling.
- Operations:
  - `checkStatus`
  - `simplePython`
  - `getArtifacts`
  - `submit`
  - `wait`
- Notes:
  - beta node;
  - expects project/flavor/time limit/image/job/artifact fields depending on operation;
  - do not use for lightweight deterministic transforms; use Code node or Python MLCore depending on the need.

### Python MLCore

- Code name: `pythonMlcore`
- Credentials: none in n8n UI; package reads environment.
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: quick Python script execution in MLCore with requirements/artifacts.
- Key fields:
  - `script`
  - `requirements`
  - `artifacts`
  - options: `flavor`, `timeLimit`, `image`
- Env dependencies:
  - `MLCORE_SA`
  - `MLCORE_TENANT`
- Agent rule: do not use this as a generic JavaScript transform. For normal item shaping, use `Code`.

### PeopleHub

- Code name: `peopleHub`
- Credential: `peopleHubApi`
- Use for: employee lookup and org/division resolution.
- Operations:
  - `employeesByLoginList`
  - `employeeByEmail`
  - `employeeBySiebelId`
  - `employeeBySocialAccount`
  - `employees`
  - `employeesByIdList`
  - `employeesInDivision`
  - `employeesByWofLoginList`
  - `employeesByTWorkIdList`
  - `employeesByResourcePositionIdList`
  - `employeesByLegalPositionIdList`
- Env dependencies:
  - `PEOPLEHUB_SECRET_KEY`
  - `TWORK_INTEGRATION_URL`
  - `PEOPLEHUB_URL`

### Rag Platform

- Code name: `ragPlatform`
- Default node version: `2`
- Credential: `ragPlatformV2Api`; legacy version 1 uses `ragPlatformApi`.
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: RAG project/datasource management, file upload and chunk query.
- Operations:
  - `createDatasource`
  - `createProject`
  - `deleteDatasource`
  - `deleteProject`
  - `getEtlStatus`
  - `listDatasources`
  - `queryChunks`
  - `uploadFile`

### DWH (DLH - Trino)

- Code name: `trino`
- Credential: `trinoApi`
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: SQL against DWH through Trino.
- Key fields:
  - `query`
  - `timeout` in seconds
- Rules:
  - add `LIMIT` unless the business contract explicitly requires full output;
  - node returns the last statement result if multiple SQL statements are sent;
  - large result sets can fail; keep output bounded and aggregate in SQL when possible.

### Sage

- Code name: `sage`
- Default node version: `1.2`
- Credential: `devplatformApi`; legacy versions 1/1.1 use `sageApi`.
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: Mage queries, short links to Sage searches and alert mutes.
- Operations:
  - `sendRequest`
  - `createShortLink`
  - `createMute`
- Rules:
  - for new workflows use version 1.2 with the Dev Platform service account;
  - mute start/end are UTC timestamps and at least one condition is required;
  - use a bounded `maxResults` for searches.

### T-Tracker

- Code name: `tTracker`
- Credentials:
  - `spiritOAuth2Api` for delegated user authentication (default);
  - `devplatformApi` for a service account.
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Use for: T-Tracker tasks and related entities.
- Resources and operations:
  - `task`: `changeStatus`, `create`, `get`, `search`, `update`
  - `comment`: `add`, `delete`, `get`, `getAll`, `update`
  - `taskLink`: `create`, `delete`, `get`
  - `remoteLink`: `create`, `delete`, `getAll`
  - `sprint`: `addTasks`, `delete`, `get`, `getAll`, `getTasks`, `removeTasks`, `update`
  - `field`: `createCategory`, `deleteCategory`, `getAll`, `getCategories`, `getCategory`, `updateCategory`
  - `workflow`: `assign`, `delete`, `get`, `getAll`, `getAllForSpace`, `getForTaskType`, `removeMapping`, `update`
  - `release`: `addTask`, `delete`, `get`, `getAll`, `getTasks`, `removeTask`, `update`
  - `spaceGroup`: `create`, `delete`, `get`, `getAll`, `getSpaces`, `update`
  - `space`: `getById`, `getByKey`
  - `board`: `get`
  - `reference`: `getIssueTypes`, `getPriorities`, `getStatuses`
- Rules:
  - prefer delegated Spirit Sign In for user-scoped actions;
  - TQL, space keys, statuses and entity IDs must come from the user/API, not the model;
  - bound `search`/`getAll` operations with their limit/offset fields.

### T-Tracker Trigger

- Code name: `tTrackerTrigger`
- Use for: task-created and task-updated events from the public T-Tracker topic.
- Events:
  - `taskCreated`
  - `taskUpdated`
- Filters: space key, status, type and priority.
- Notes:
  - requires instance-side Kafka/Redis configuration;
  - manual execution waits up to 60 seconds;
  - the event contains a bounded task snapshot, so fetch the task explicitly when full data is needed.

### Vault

- Code name: `vault`
- Credential: `vaultApi` (AppRole).
- `usableAsTool`: yes
- Operation: `getSecret`
- Use for: retrieving one secret object or one key from HashiCorp Vault.
- Rules:
  - do not expose this tool to an untrusted/general-purpose agent;
  - do not persist its output in workflow JSON, logs, saved execution data or Sticky Notes;
  - disable successful execution data where the workflow contract permits it;
  - use `includeMetadata` only when metadata is actually needed.

### LLM Proxy

#### T-Bank LLM proxy

- Code name: `llmProxy`
- Credential: `openAiApi`
- Output: AI language model for AI Agent / AI Chain.
- Use for: production LLM calls through the internal OpenAI-compatible proxy.

#### T-Bank LLM proxy with Langfuse

- Code name: `llmProxyWithLangfuse`
- Credentials: `openAiApi`, `langfuseApi`
- Use for: LLM calls that require Langfuse tracing.
- Extra config: `sessionId`, `userId`, `traceId`, `traceName`, `metadata`.

#### T-Bank LLM DEMO

- Code name: `llmProxyManual`
- Credentials: none.
- Env dependencies:
  - `SIMPLE_AI_API_KEY`
  - optional `AI_BASE_URL`
- Rule: manual/demo only; do not use in production automation.

LLM rule: if JSON output is required, the prompt must explicitly ask for JSON. Still validate and repair shape in a deterministic Code node.

### FineDog

- Code name: `fineDog`
- Credential: `fineDogApi`
- Use for: read/search operations for incidents, releases, schedules, teams, units, pages, suspicions and post-analysis.
- Env dependencies:
  - `FINEDOG_CLIENT_ID`
  - `FINEDOG_CLIENT_SECRET`
  - optional `FINEDOG_BASE_URL`
- Resources and operations:
  - `auth`: `whoami`
  - `incident`: `get`, `getBlackActive`, `getComments`, `getTimeline`, `list`
  - `page`: `list`
  - `postAnalysis`: `get`, `getReasons`, `getTriggers`, `search`
  - `release`: `get`, `getApprovals`, `search`, `searchFreezes`
  - `scenario`: `list`
  - `schedule`: `list`
  - `suspicion`: `get`, `list`
  - `team`: `get`, `list`, `listMembers`
  - `unit`: `get`, `getConsumerTypes`, `getState`, `list`
- Notes:
  - beta node;
  - the current UI contract exposes only the operations listed above;
  - execute code still contains legacy write branches, but an agent must not treat hidden branches as supported operations.

## Credential Summary

| Credential | Used by | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|
| `allureApi` | Allure | Dev Platform backed token flow |
| `spiritOAuth2Api` | Wiki, Jira, n8n MCP, T-Tracker | Reusable personal Spirit Sign In; one credential can serve multiple nodes |
| `confluenceApi` | Wiki PAT mode; Kronos event operations | Bearer token style wiki credential |
| `devplatformApi` | Dev Platform, GitLab, GitLab Trigger, Sage, T-Tracker | Service-account backed token flow |
| `fineDogApi` | FineDog | Token created from environment client credentials |
| `gitlabApi` | GitLab | Private token style auth |
| `jiraSoftwareServerPatApi` | Jira | Server personal access token |
| `jiraSoftwareTcsApi` | Jira legacy TCS mode | Legacy instance credential; prefer Spirit delegated auth for new nodes |
| `jiraSoftwareCloudApi` / `jiraSoftwareServerApi` | Jira v1 | Legacy cloud/server credentials; not offered by the default v2.1 contract |
| `mlcoreApi` | MLC Job | Service-account backed token flow |
| `peopleHubApi` | PeopleHub | Token created from PeopleHub/TWork env config |
| `ragPlatformV2Api` | Rag Platform v2 | Current API key credential; v1 uses `ragPlatformApi` |
| `ragPlatformApi` | Rag Platform v1 | Legacy RAG credential |
| `sageApi` | Sage v1/1.1 | Legacy Sage token; v1.2 uses `devplatformApi` |
| `trinoApi` | Trino | User/password credential |
| `tworkApi` | No registered node in v0.3.26 | Compatibility credential; do not select it without a confirmed consumer |
| `vaultApi` | Vault | AppRole `roleId`/`secretId`; never publish credential values or node output |
| `openAiApi` | LLM proxy nodes | OpenAI-compatible proxy credential |
| `langfuseApi` | LLM proxy with Langfuse | Tracing credential |

## Nessy / Weak Model Workflow

1. Read `SKILL.md`, `references/node-patterns.md`, then this file.
2. Choose the domain from `Decision Matrix`.
3. Check that the target n8n has a live export/template using this custom node.
4. Copy `type`, `typeVersion`, credential shape and known parameters from live export/template.
5. Use only `resource/operation` listed here.
6. If a required field is unknown, add a `Sticky Note` with `TODO in UI`; do not invent it.
7. For write operations, start with read/list/get where possible and keep side effects behind an explicit trigger/confirmation path.
8. After create/update, tell the user to open UI, configure credentials, save and activate if webhook/trigger registration is needed.
